actions: Restored only evaluation role-local state under the frozen sanitized control tuple.
Inspected fresh public repeated-inference nondeterminism evidence, including vLLM issue 50603 and the independent dual-radeon-vllm gfx1100 benchmark summary.
Added cluster_mismatch_anytime_certifier.py for top-level process/workload rare-mismatch certification and then corrected/extended it with nested-test inversion for a stable conditional-mean p.
Added summary_divergence_adapter.py to keep protected score/sign UNKNOWN when a public artifact reports only raw/token divergence.
Added cluster_average_conditional_mean_cs.py, a fixed bounded-mgf mixture CS for a time-varying average conditional mean with no independence requirement across top-level clusters.
Benchmarked the drifting-average CS against the public Chugg-Ramdas 2025 exact empirical-Bernstein implementation in a low-rate synthetic cluster regime.
Persisted successive checkpoints and advanced evaluation/LATEST by CAS/readback.
material_findings: Repeated requests inside one server/process lifetime must not be counted as independent mismatch trials; process/workload clustering can change a nominal zero-failure rate claim by orders of magnitude.

Public gfx1100 evidence now includes persistent warmed same-process token divergence on a second stack, but the summary does not publish full per-run token arrays; protected scorer/sign status therefore remains UNKNOWN.

Nested stable-p cluster tests invert to an upper CS without extra alpha cost at a target tolerance; a prior checkpoint statement attributing the power gain to 'threshold test versus full CS' was explicitly corrected.
A separate bounded-mgf construction gives an anytime upper CS for the time-varying average conditional mean itself, tolerating arbitrary cross-cluster dependence through conditional expectations.

In the tested rare binary-cluster regime, that simple one-sided construction reached a 1% upper endpoint after 368 zero clusters versus 1009 for Chugg-Ramdas exact CR at kappa=.25 and about 562 at large kappa; it was tighter in 45/52 scenarios against fixed kappa=4 but slightly worse on some early-mismatch paths.
termination_cause: automation invocation turn boundary after multiple material checkpoints; frontier remains nonempty
exact_next_action: Optimize a predeclared lambda/weight portfolio for 0.1%-5% rare mismatch under zero plus sparse early/late failures, then compare worst-case delay against a fixed Chugg-Ramdas kappa=4 policy without outcome-dependent method selection.
